title: 联赛球队名单
problem_statement_md:
假设有一张各联赛足球队表**teams**，数据如下：

![](/content/assets/209fbffb5f71a114fdc7.jpeg)

列字段含义:
- `teamname`: 队名
- `county`: 所在国家

写一个查询，输出国家在`Spain`、 `England` 或 `Germany` 的球队名及国家名。
problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]The IN Operator[/h1][/s0l0!-header]

You are sorting football teams by leagues and given the following table named [b]teams[/b]. [img id="4536" width="100%"]Write a query to output the team names and the countries of all teams that have played in La Liga (Spain), Premier League (England) and Bundesliga (Germany)․
[note]Use the [b]IN [/b]operator.[/note]

code_templates.prepend_code:
CREATE TABLE teams (
  id int,
  teamname VARCHAR(128),
  country VARCHAR(128)
);

INSERT INTO teams (id,teamname,country)
VALUES
(1,'FC Barcelona','Spain'),
(2,'FC Bayern Munich','Germany'),
(3,'FC Chelsea','England'),
(4,'FC Roma','Italy'),
(5,'FC Leon','France'),
(6,'FC Ajax','Nederland');
